resources.string: Check or confirm your email address
A quick check for your email
Send a confirmation link to your email, then return here to check your status.
Confirmation link sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
Your email isn’t confirmed yet. Open the link in your inbox, then check again.
The link confirms your email address. Your phone verification is separate.
Your email address is verified. You’re ready to continue.
Sign in to the account whose email you want to confirm.
This account doesn’t have an email address to confirm.
Try again to check your current email and verification status.
Check your connection and try again.
Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
Couldn’t check your email status. Please try again.
Couldn’t send the confirmation link. Please try again.
Your email is confirmed, but the status couldn’t be saved to your profile. You can retry.
Your account changed. Check your current account before continuing.
